## Core Specializations & Architecture

- **Native Android Engineering**: Kotlin, Java, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, Android Jetpack (Lifecycle, Navigation, WorkManager, Room, Paging3, DataStore).
- **Cross-Platform Engineering**: Flutter, Dart, Riverpod, Bloc, Platform Channels, Custom Renderers, HealthKit / Google Fit integrations.
- **System Architecture**: Clean Architecture, Reactive MVI (Model-View-Intent), Unidirectional Data Flow (UDF), Modular Multi-Module Gradle setups, Dependency Injection (Hilt, Koin).
- **Asynchronous & Reactive Programming**: Kotlin Coroutines, StateFlow, SharedFlow, Channels, RxJava.
- **AI & Applied Engineering**: LLM Application Development, Advanced RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), Autonomous Agent Frameworks, MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server integration, Python automation (Playwright).
- **Quality & Reliability**: 99.8%+ Crash-Free rate across 1M+ active users, Unit/UI Testing (MockK, JUnit5, Turbine, Espresso), CI/CD Automation (GitHub Actions, Fastlane).

## Key Production Applications

1. **[Albert Health](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=v2.albert.health)**: AI-driven voice health assistant & chronic condition management platform (Flutter, Riverpod, Firebase, HealthKit). Over 500K+ downloads.
2. **[Yolda Carrier](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yolda.carrier)**: Enterprise logistics and freight operations application with real-time route optimization and offline telemetry (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Google Maps).
3. **[Biletino](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.biletino.app)**: Major event discovery and high-volume ticket booking platform (Kotlin, Flutter, Room Database, Custom Payment Gateway SDKs).
4. **[Kolay HR](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kolayik.kolay)**: All-in-one corporate HR mobile management platform (Kotlin, Hilt, Coroutines, WorkManager).
5. **[ABC Trainerize](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.trainerize.Trainerize)**: Global fitness coaching and client management ecosystem serving 1M+ active subscribers (Kotlin, Java, Modular Architecture).
6. **[Visa Sponsorship Daily Jobs](https://github.com/AlirezaNezami96)**: Open-source automated job discovery engine filtering visa-sponsored tech roles (Python, Playwright, GitHub Actions).
